sentences.text:
Of The Protection Of Children From ... vs In Re: Somnath Hazra
on 13 August, 2024
Author: Soumen Sen Bench: Soumen Sen 13.08.2024

In Re:- An application for anticipatory bail under section 438 of the Code  Criminal Procedure corresponding to Section 482 of the Bharatiya Nagarik  Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 in connection with Nakashipara Police Station Case  No. 573 of 2024 dated 26.06.2024 corresponding to POCSO No. 70 of 2024  under Sections 376/306/323/34 of the Indian Penal Code read with Section 6  of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act.
 And  In Re: Somnath Hazra  Petitioner  Mr. Asis Kumar Bisws  Mr. Amit Singh  Ms. Piyu Mandal For the Petitioner  Ms. Anasuya Sinha  Mr. Tirtha Paul For the State
Mr. Snehansu Majumder For the De-facto Complainant

1.
Heard the learned counsel appearing for the parties.

2. Considering the statement of the mother of the victim recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C read with the statement of the Doctor recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C regarding the post-mortem report that there was a possibility of ectopic pregnancy at the time of her death and having regard to the involvement of the petitioner in the commission of the alleged offence, we are not inclined to grant anticipatory bail to the petitioner.
3. Accordingly, the prayer for anticipatory bail of the petitioner is rejected and the same is accordingly disposed of.

4. All parties shall act on the server copies of this order duly downloaded from the official website of Of The Protection Of Children From ... vs In Re: Somnath Hazra on 13 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/42402826/
